title: Clear Pocket is Nice
text: Clear Pocket is Nice. My daughter is going off to college in the fall and I thought these would be nice for protecting some of her nicer clothing. When I ordered them, I didn't pay attention to the actual measurements, but the description I got said "24''×32'' It is suitable for storing short coat, dress, sweater, T-shirt and child's clothes". In actuality, it won't fit all of the intended items because it's too short. We may be able to find some sweaters or short coats to put in them, but for most clothing items, these are way too short. Now, disregarding the length, the covers are made well. They material is very thin and light weight. The clear pocket is a nice feature so you can see what's inside without unzipping it. Overall, they're okay.
